title: A reply about garden plot signs
titleZh: 回覆菜園地塊標牌事宜
passage:
To: Jamie Park
From: Noor, Cedar Court Community Garden
Subject: Replacement plot signs

Thanks for sending a photo of plot 18. The number is still readable, but the bottom of the wooden sign has split. We now use ceramic tiles for the plot numbers. If your number has not changed, there is no charge for replacing a wooden sign.

Please leave the wooden sign in place until you receive the tile. The garden crew uses the numbers to find the plots that need work. When your tile arrives, hang it on the outside of the gate, where it can be read from the path.

The garden shop has the even-numbered tiles ready. Pick one up from the garden shop on Wednesday evening. If you cannot collect it then, the crew can leave it in the storage box by the entrance on Saturday; tell us by Thursday if you need that option. The shop will not be open to visitors on Saturday.

If your plot is being divided, don't pick up the old number, even if it is damaged. Ask the office for the new numbers after the division is recorded.
passageZh:
收件人：Jamie Park
寄件人：Cedar Court 社區菜園的 Noor
主旨：更換地塊標牌

謝謝你寄來 18 號地塊的照片。號碼仍可辨讀，但木牌底部已裂開。我們現在改用陶瓷牌標示地塊號碼。如果號碼沒變，更換木牌不收費。

收到陶瓷牌前，請把木牌留在原處。菜園工作小組靠這些號碼找到需要整理的地塊。收到陶瓷牌後，請把它掛在大門外側，讓人在步道上就能看清楚。

菜園商店已備妥偶數號的陶瓷牌，請在星期三晚上到商店領取。如果那時無法領取，工作小組可在星期六把陶瓷牌放在入口旁的置物箱；需要這個安排，請最遲星期四通知我們。商店星期六不對訪客開放。

如果你的地塊正在分割，就算標牌壞了，也先不要領取舊號碼的牌子。分割完成登記後，請向辦公室詢問新號碼。
